name: start-opus-flash
description: Experimental (2026-11-23, PLAN.md; F120, F124, F126, F133): start or grow a project with Claude Opus 5.5 deciding and Gemini 3.8 Flash building on Google's quota. Opus leads: it plans with the acceptance cases written as a test file (on a new project the file names the modules the developers create), picks a developer per task and reviews only when the tests or checks fail, at most twice. Flash medium builds, climbs to Flash high, then Claude Haiku 5.5 high (also the fallback when Gemini is out of quota or capacity), then Claude Sonnet 5.5 high as senior. A small request goes to Flash alone with no Opus turn. Sonnet plans when Opus's window is spent. Not yet measured live.
